nodes.speaker: Mov
nodes.text: Couriers move through the atrium. Gold terminals are safe, red sniffers raise Trace. Robe hides you near them — twice.

nodes.speaker: Evelor
nodes.text: Clean shadow. Three cycles, zero Trace that matters. Silverchat will take your poll.

hints: Hunters walk loops and wait — they don't kill. Trace is the enemy: adjacency +20.
Robe (J) freezes hunters within 3 for 6 turns. Spend it crossing the middle.
Trace 60 wakes the sleeper in the walls. Finish under it or outrun him.
